{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI/CD
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule: [{cron: '1 0 * * 6'}]
env:
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
  COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD: "1"
  BUILDKIT_PROGRESS: "plain"
  RELEASABLE_REPOS: "^pallets-eco/croniter"
  RELEASABLE_BRANCHES: "^(refs/heads/)?(master|main|new-packaging)$"
  FORCE_COLOR: "true"
permissions: {}
jobs:
  test-code-QA:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.13"]
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Cache tox environments
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: .tox
        key: test-code-QA-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}-toxQA-${{ hashFiles('**/pyproject.toml') }}
    - name: Cache uv
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: test-code-QA-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}-uvQA-${{ hashFiles('**/pyproject.toml') }}
    - name: Install uv and tox
      shell: sh
      run: |
        curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
        uv tool install tox
    - name: formatters check
      run: tox -e lint,mypy,fmt

  test-py3:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Cache tox environments
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: .tox
        key: test-py3-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}-tox-${{ hashFiles('**/pyproject.toml') }}
    - name: Cache uv
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: test-py3-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}-uvQA-${{ hashFiles('**/pyproject.toml') }}
    - name: Install uv and tox
      shell: sh
      run: |
        curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
        uv tool install tox
    - name: run tests with coverage
      run: tox -e cov

  test-32bits:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Test with pytest
      run: |
         docker compose run --build --rm --env FORCE_COLOR=true --env UV_LINK_MODE=copy app tox -e test
      env:
        COMPOSE_FILE: "docker-compose.yml:docker-compose-build.yml:docker-compose-32bits.yml"",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a matrix of Python versions (3.9–3.13) in the test-py3 job. Currently, `fail-fast: false` causes all matrix legs to run even when one fails, wasting CI resources. Experimental evidence (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) shows that enabling `fail-fast: true` cancels remaining matrix jobs after a failure, reducing elapsed time without affecting required checks (the repository has no verified required checks that depend on all matrix outcomes). The same change is applied to test-code-QA for consistency, though its matrix has only one version. This optimization is supported by two experimental records with scenario_passed outcomes and aligns with the pattern's estimated benefit (2% free, 1.5% paid VM time reduction). No other changes are made, preserving all existing caching, test coverage, and the 32-bit Docker test job.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997"]
}
